$comment: Annotations for files and directories that differ from upstream. Keys are file paths (or directory paths with trailing slash). Each entry has a description and optional links (paths relative to project root).

fuzz_output/.description: Output directory for the Archipelago fuzzer (error logs, explain stats, and report.json).

CC/.description: Claude Code scripts, plans, and utilities for AI-assisted development.

apworlds/.description: Pre-built APWorld packages (.apworld files) for distribution.

docs/json/.description: Documentation portal for the JSON Export Tools project: user guides, developer docs, architecture, and test results.

exporter/.description: Python module that exports game logic (items, locations, regions, rules) to JSON format after seed generation.

frontend/.description: Web client application for browsing exported game data, viewing rules, and running spoiler tests.

json_tools_patches/.description: Versioned patches for ROM-less generation and other core file modifications, organized by Archipelago version.

scripts/.description: Build, test, setup, and documentation generation scripts.

test_json/.description: Test suite for fork-specific modules: exporter, rule builder, world generator, and E2E spoiler tests.

world_generator/.description: Converts JSON rules files back into functional Archipelago world packages (Python code).

worlds/apcalc/.description: APCalc fork game world (calculator-themed), authored against the fork's Rule Builder (RuleWorldMixin).

worlds/ut_pickle/.description: Universal Tracker 'UT Pickle Mode' variant providing pickle-based deferred tracking.

worlds/apworld_manager/.description: Third-party meta-world (hidden) for installing and managing APWorlds from repositories. Unmodified from upstream source.

worlds/bakingadventure/.description: Original demo world: a baking-themed game with progression-based locations.

worlds/codingadventure/.description: Original demo world: an educational web development game with progression items.

worlds/depgraph/.description: Original world that turns any directed acyclic graph (DAG) into a playable Archipelago world.

iframe_games/.description: Iframe-hosted game content for frontend integration modules.

worlds/jta/.description: Journey to Ascension: a demo world with cost-based progression and planner integration.

worlds/json_tools_installer/.description: Utility APWorld (hidden) that downloads and installs JSON Tools components on vanilla Archipelago.

worlds/metamath/.description: Original demo world that turns MetaMath formal proofs into playable Archipelago worlds.

worlds/rulebuilder_test/.description: Tiny hidden world that exercises the rule_builder feature surface end-to-end (Python generation → exporter → frontend evaluation), including a game-specific custom Rule subclass, FieldResolver counts, and dynamic Has.count forms.

worlds/toem_original/.description: Original TOEM world implementation (non-Rule Builder version, used as a comparison benchmark).

worlds/toem_rule_builder/.description: TOEM world implemented using Rule Builder syntax (benchmark for comparing against the original implementation).

worlds/tracker/.description: Universal Tracker meta-world (hidden) for in-game location tracking and logic visualization. Modified from FarisTheAncient's version.

worlds/adventure_worldgen2/.description: Second-generation world: generated from a worldgen world to test cross-generation compatibility.

worlds/ahit_worldgen2/.description: Second-generation world: generated from a worldgen world to test cross-generation compatibility.

worlds/shorthike_worldgen2/.description: Second-generation world: generated from a worldgen world to test cross-generation compatibility.

Main.py.description: Excludes JSON-Tools exporter artifacts (rules JSON, sphere log, pickle) from the hostable .zip so a stock WebHost upload doesn't reject the archive.

.gitattributes.description: Added `merge=ours` strategy for `.gitignore` and `README.md` to preserve fork versions during upstream merges.

.gitignore.description: Added patterns for fork-specific files: JSDoc output, frontend presets, test results, node_modules, worldgen output, and disabled worlds.

README.md.description: Replaced upstream README with fork-specific documentation describing the JSON Export Tools project and web client demo.

pytest.ini.description: Added `test_json` to pytest test discovery paths for fork-specific test modules.

requirements.txt.description: Relaxed the typing_extensions pin from `==4.15.0` to `>=4.15.0,<5`. CI's ModuleUpdate --force pip-installs every world's requirements file with --upgrade; zillion's `typing-extensions>=4.7,<5` upgraded past the exact core pin when 4.16.0 released, killing every unittests matrix job at setup.

settings.py.description: Added `skip_required_files` global, `Group.__getattribute__` bypass for missing ROM paths, and early extraction from host.yaml `json_tools` section.

.github/workflows/unittests.yml.description: Adds PYTHONUTF8/PYTHONIOENCODING env to the Unittests step so pytest-xdist stdout teardown doesn't fail on Windows cp1252.

.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml.description: Added explicit `security-events`, `actions`, and `contents` permissions for safer fork operation.

.github/workflows/scan-build.yml.description: Added a `workflow_dispatch` trigger so the native-code static analysis can be run manually.

rule_builder/__init__.py.description: Full API exports for all rule types, AST format support, pathfinding tools, and documentation. Upstream file is empty.

rule_builder/rules.py.description: Upstream base kept byte-identical except minimal additive edits (base get_value/get_count/to_dict/__lshift__, widened Has.count, _make_hashable for HelperCall args). The 15 fork rule types, RuleWorldMixin, and AST support live in separate overlay modules (extra_rules.py, world_mixin.py, ast_*).

test/general/test_items.py.description: Added DLCQuest coin exclusion and logic to propagate item exclusions from base games to WorldGen variant worlds.

test/general/test_reachability.py.description: Added shapez unreachable region and logic to propagate unreachable regions from base games to WorldGen variant worlds.

test/general/test_rule_builder.py.description: Added ~600 lines of evaluation tests for fork-only Rule Builder rule types: CountItem, CountFromList, Compare, Arithmetic, MinValue, MaxValue, WeightedSum, and more.

worlds/alttp/Rules.py.description: Fixed Python late binding bug in superbunny path lambdas that caused rules to always evaluate to True.

worlds/landstalker/Hints.py.description: Changed `list(set(...))` to `sorted(set(...))` for deterministic hint ordering before seeded shuffle.

worlds/lufia2ac/Options.py.description: Changed `set(random_groups)` to `list(random_groups)` so `enumerate()` assigns stable integer keys for deterministic JSON export.

worlds/shapez/__init__.py.description: Removed forced `early_balancer_tunnel_and_trash = 0` override during UT regeneration that made UT more permissive than the server.

worlds/alttp/__init__.py.description: Added `check_rom_available()` to skip ROM generation when `skip_required_files` is enabled.

worlds/alttp/EnemyShuffle.py.description: Skip the enemizer base-ROM read in `generate_enemy_shuffle_state()` when the ROM is absent (`check_rom_available`); enemy shuffle is a ROM-only effect, so the state stays `None`.

worlds/ff1/__init__.py.description: Added skip_required_files support to allow generation without key items.

worlds/lufia2ac/__init__.py.description: Added `check_rom_available()` to skip ROM generation when `skip_required_files` is enabled.

.gitmodules.description: Submodule definitions for frontend/modules/shared and frontend/modules/textAdventureEngine.

conftest.py.description: Root pytest conftest that filters upstream Archipelago worlds out of collection and AutoWorldRegister so CI only exercises this fork's own code.

.flake8.description: Fork-owned flake8 config (upstream ships none): excludes the byte-pristine vendored Universal Tracker fixtures under scripts/test/fixtures/, whose Python 3.12+ f-string syntax is a hard SyntaxError for flake8 on 3.11.

vitest.slow.config.js.description: Vitest config for the slow/long-running JS test suite (e.g. full-solver braid cross-checks).

vitest.calib.config.js.description: Manual calibration vitest tier (not in CI): home for the demoted heavy runner sweeps that define gate windows but do not need to run every battery (`npm run test:unit:calib`).

CLAUDE.md.description: Quick reference for Claude Code with common commands, key concepts, and project conventions.

fuzz.py.description: Archipelago fuzzer for random YAML generation testing, adapted from Eijebong's Archipelago-fuzzer.
